text:
Aisha: Quick sync  we need a final call on the new 'silent-switch' fallback option. goal: let requests fall back without spamming ops during transient noise, but keep enough audit/telemetry to diagnose if it goes sideways.
Connor: +1. main questions: how do we surface degradations later? console? alerts? logs only?
Ruth: minimal alerts by default. rate-limited operator notification if fallback rate >5% for 10m. ops shouldn't be woken for every tiny blip. :zzz:
Ben: On the API side we can add notify_operator:boolean and audit_sample_rate:float. default notify_operator=false for silent-switch. product wants easy opt-in.
Shawn: UX ask  in rollout panel show compact badge "Silent fallback active" with click-to-expand timeline and sampled list of example requests (PII scrubbed). also quick toggle to promote to 'loud' mode.
Aisha: question: do we record every fallback event to bigtable and sample at ingestion, or sample at router and tag with reason/error_class? sampling at router is cheaper but loses complete forensic trace.
Connor: sample at router and include sampling_id + quota_used + error_class; store full dump only for sampled ids. console playback can rehydrate sampled traces.
Ruth: audit retention  enterprise customers will want full audit on request for 90 days. propose: sampled telemetry by default + backfill/export API for Private/Dedicated customers.
Ben: API contract sketch:
{ "fallback_mode": "silent-switch", "notify_operator": false, "audit_sample_rate": 0.02, "escalation_threshold": {"percent": 5, "window_seconds": 600} }
Ruth: +1 on escalation threshold. also add "recently_escalated" flag in UI to prevent repeated noise.
Shawn: small UX nit  hover the badge to show: "Silent switch: non-disruptive fallback. Escalate if >5% in 10m" and link "view sampled traces". keep panel terse.
Connor: telemetry payload should include: route_id, model_variant_from, model_variant_to, latency_ms_before, latency_ms_after, error_class, sampling_id, operator_notified:boolean. minimal and actionable.
Aisha: ops concern: if notify_operator flips to true during an active incident it could double-alert. gate operator notifications through a dedupe layer (same incident id) and rate-limit 1 alert / 5m per team.
Ben: I'll add fallback_reason + sampling_id fields to router schema.
deploy-bot: :white_check_mark: canary roll started (10% traffic) for 'silent-switch' flags. see https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/1749807654
Ruth: last question  audit logs should include compact hash linking sampled event -> full log blob (if present) so we can revoke access for compliance.
Aisha: capture that. action items: Ben to PR API schema, Connor to add sampling_id + minimal payload in router, Shawn to mock badge/hover in rollout panel, Ruth to draft escalation policy text for legal/enterprise. reconvene tomorrow EOD. :calendar:
